session.name: Live proving run attempt 1 - infrastructure half debugged end to end

goal.original: Sync the Pod lock, then run the full smoke matrix so release:check stops failing and 1.4 can be cut.
goal.summary: The Pod lock question turned out to need NO image rebuild. The smoke run itself was attempted three times and never reached the GPU stage, because the runner's infrastructure half had never been executed and carried SIX faults. All six are now fixed, committed and guarded. ~97 GB of the ~300 GB fill is already on the volume. No GPU has been rented; nothing has been smoked yet.

completed: POD LOCK: no rebuild was owed, and the card said otherwise. MPI-472 added imageio-ffmpeg to python_deps AFTER the pod sync, but that pin is WINDOWS-PORTABLE-ONLY: MpiNodes help_funcs.py find_ffmpeg() resolves VHS_FORCE_FFMPEG_PATH -> imageio_ffmpeg -> shutil.which("ffmpeg"), and both Pod Dockerfiles apt-install ffmpeg (Dockerfile:72, Dockerfile.cpu:29). start.sh:234-235 already documented this. Byte drift closed in mpi-ci 27087c2 with NO rebuild; v0.20.0-dev stays current. MPI-467 checklist corrected.

RUNNER FAULT 1 (f1df91fa): no CPU download Pod was ever created. /comfy/models/download/start only goes remote when isRemoteActive(), so ~300 GB would have downloaded to the LOCAL disk. Now creates the __cpu__ Pod and asserts /remote/mode active before the first POST.

RUNNER FAULT 2 (f1df91fa): the probe image was injected as a Windows path. MpiLoadImageFromPath runs os.path.isfile ON THE POD, so every op with a required image would have self-gated to "no media" - a FAIL that reads as a broken model. Now uploads via /remote/upload/media and injects the Pod-absolute path.

RUNNER FAULT 3 (f1df91fa): the install wait ignored `installing`/`paused` and never checked for failed deps. Now waits on all four in-flight statuses and asserts no failure BEFORE renting a GPU (playbook step 4).

RUNNER FAULT 4 (6001376a): a cold -cpu Pod answers /health before /wrapper/models/install exists. All 12 ltx-23-balanced deps died to that window in 0.2s while later models were fine. One retry round per model now absorbs it. Also carded the UX half as MPI-480 (the transient 404 opened the REPORT ON GITHUB dialog; routes/remoteModels.js:89 says it must be a toast).

RUNNER FAULT 5 (d6f1c7fc): the runner POSTed all 13 models at once = 63 concurrent wrapper installs. That starved a cpu3c Pod into 524-ing every route including /health; the SSE died every 90s and the fill flat-lined near 97 GB for ninety minutes while the app counters froze at 82.9 GB. Installs are now sequential, one model drained before the next - the shape the model manager ships (MPI-184).

RUNNER FAULT 6 (899e118f): GET /runpod/volumes returns a BARE ARRAY; the runner destructured {volumes, networkVolumes} off it, saw an empty list and created a NEW 350 GB volume on every run. THREE existed before it was caught. Now reads the array, refuses to guess between same-named volumes, and takes --volume <id>. The user deleted the two empty twins.

WATCHDOGS (e60b269b): the two blind spots that needed a human watching the RunPod console. Pod creation now has a 4-minute boot budget then recycles the host up to 3 times (RunPod reports RUNNING for a Pod whose container loops "network must exist"), and the per-model wait tracks downloaded bytes, treating 10 minutes of no movement as a dead Pod - recycle, re-POST, aria2 resumes from the volume.

PLAYBOOK (dc7a738e): all of the above written into docs/playbooks/bump-engine/01-smoke-run.md with how each fault PRESENTED, since the presentation is the trap (SSE-fed counters freeze, so a dead reporter looks exactly like a stalled download).

BOARD: MPI-450 (the real 1.4 gate umbrella) unblocked todo/blocked -> doing/in-progress; Gate E is complete. MPI-367 -> todo/deferred (its copy ships as-is in 1.4, user decision). MPI-480 created. A malformed JSONL line in MPI-367/events.jsonl repaired. validate_board.py passes.
